articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between LLM outputs and expert-level domain work.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Sets New State of the Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which achieves top scores on SWE-Bench Verified and real-world repository-scale coding tasks, outperforming previous frontier models. The model introduces improved tool-use orchestration that allows it to autonomously plan, execute, and debug multi-file software projects with minimal human intervention.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot in select Fremont and Austin factory lines, performing parts kitting, inspection, and light assembly tasks alongside human workers. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C, Announces Commercial Humanoid Deployment with BMW
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation, fueled by a production contract with BMW to deploy Figure 02 robots in Spartanburg plant logistics operations. The deal represents one of the first large-scale commercial deployments of general-purpose humanoid robots outside of a pilot program.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Persistent Memory and Sandboxed Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic released a major update to its Claude platform, enabling fully autonomous agents that can maintain persistent memory across sessions, execute code in sandboxed environments, and interact with external APIs under user-defined safety constraints. The system uses a constitutional AI-derived supervision layer to prevent unsafe tool invocations in enterprise deployments.

articles.title: ASML Reports Record EUV High-NA Orders as Chip Fabricators Race to 1.4nm Nodes
articles.summary: ASML disclosed record quarterly bookings for its next-generation high-NA EUV lithography systems, driven by TSMC and Intel orders targeting sub-2nm process nodes expected in 2027-2028. The high-NA systems enable 8nm-pitch patterning in a single exposure, reducing multi-patterning complexity and potentially lowering per-transistor costs for future AI accelerator chips.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 1,000-Cycle Durability in EV-Format Cells
articles.summary: QuantumScape published independently validated data showing its multi-layer solid-state lithium-metal cells retained over 90% capacity after 1,000 fast-charge cycles in automotive-format pouches. The results address a long-standing durability concern for solid-state technology and bring the company closer to its planned 2027 commercial production with Volkswagen's PowerCo.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Completes Autonomous Disaster Response Trial with FEMA
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' fully electric Atlas humanoid robot completed a week-long autonomous disaster response trial in partnership with FEMA, navigating collapsed structures, opening doors, and carrying supply payloads up to 25kg without remote operator assistance. The trial marks a significant milestone in deploying legged humanoid platforms for real-world unstructured environments beyond warehouse and factory settings.
